Definition: from κάπηλος (a huckster); to retail, i.e. (by implication) to adulterate (figuratively):--corrupt.
BiblicalUsage: Kapeleuo is to retail — to huckster, to peddle, to adulterate the goods for profit. Paul says, we are not as many, which corrupt the word of God, but as of sincerity, as of God, in the sight of God speak we in Christ.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the word of God is not a market stall: it is not to be watered down, repackaged, or sold for gain, and sincerity is the only honest way to speak it.
